tool_args.rationale: The five observations span normalized forcing u_now/0.02 and sink gradient broadly, sufficient to fit the four-parameter barrier-modulated siphon form supplied in the archive. The prior execution error was an interface-state issue (predict expected parameters that had not been stored), so this implementation stores fitted parameters in fit() and uses them in predict().

considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The sink-gradient span is 2.0, far above the stated 0.08 threshold; the branch-sign ambiguity is not indicated by this design.
This is needed for trajectory/memory ODE families, whereas evidence and the specific barrier-activation signature support the four-parameter static barrier law.
All rows share H=0.7 and there is no slow-horizon reversal signature; the pilot signatures instead indicate barrier activation and sink inhibition.
